title: Checkout latency spike with a coincident deploy and a lagging DB replica
question: What is the root cause of the checkout-api latency spike that began around 03:00?
ground_truth: Config revision r88 raised the payments client timeout from 2s to 30s six days earlier. When the payments provider slowed to about 9s p95 at 02:59, each checkout request held a worker thread for the full provider delay, exhausting the worker pool and producing the 11s p99 latency.

evidence.text: 02:58 deploy of checkout-api build 2231 completed on all 6 hosts
02:59 onward payments-provider synthetic probe p95 response time 9400ms (baseline 450ms)
03:00 to 03:30 checkout-api hosts avg cpu 38%, request rate 1120 rps (baseline 1100 rps)
config revision r88 applied 6 days ago: payments client timeout_ms changed from 2000 to 30000
03:02 checkout-api host 3 worker pool in_use 64 of 64, request queue depth 410
03:00 to 03:30 db primary query p99 14ms, slow query log empty
03:04 checkout-api host 3 thread dump: 64 of 64 workers in state socket_read to payments-provider:443
